headline: Tower Records Online is still offline; no cause, attacker or regulator statement has been published.
summary: Checked the open questions and the shop's state. The company's site still returned HTTP 503 this run, so the notice was not re-read directly (not checked: site unavailable); coverage dated Nov 24 JST (Impress Watch, ASCII, websec-center, cybersecurity-jp, eSecurity Planet) still cites the Nov 22, 6:30 PM JST update as the latest: shop stopped, shipping of placed orders planned from Nov 23 with no notice yet that it has begun, marketplace restart undetermined. No new Tier 1 or independent Tier 2 source; new pieces only restate the notice. No PPC, police, cause, attacker, ransom or compensation statement found. The 'considering reviewing retention' detail is still only in derivative pages and is not added. Added the service state (down, resting on c002) required by the Nov 24 format; no finding or label changed. Privacy check done: no bylines, officials or contacts named; help-desk links left out.
